entities.name: Saša Starović

entities.summary: Saša Starović is a Serbian retired volleyball player, a former member of Serbia men's national volleyball team, a participant of the Olympic Games, European Champion 2011, bronze medalist of World Championship 2010, medalist of the European Championship and the World League.
